show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/YF58xU
show.description: Love You Papa is an emotional rebirth drama about betrayal, second chances, and unbreakable bonds. Billionaire heir Rudra Agnihotri dies after being deceived by his greedy mother, only to wake up 14 years in the past—back in his childhood. With memories of his tragic fate intact, Rudra vows to protect his father, rebuild their lives, and change destiny itself, no matter who stands in the way.
